summary: Maase Inc. files Form 6-K to provide audited combined financial statements of Times Good Limited, acquired 100% on March 30, 2026, and unaudited pro forma combined financials. No terms, price, or premium disclosed. The acquisition closed previously; this is a post-closing financial filing. Board recommendation and advisors not stated. The filing incorporates by reference into a Form S-8. What to watch: integration progress; risk-arb angle not applicable as deal is closed.
